tip: Standard question for asking the time.

sentence: Um wie viel Uhr beginnt der Kurs?
translation_en: At what time does the course begin?

sentence: Der Kurs beginnt um acht Uhr.
translation_en: The course begins at eight o'clock.

sentence: Ich stehe um sechs Uhr auf.
translation_en: I get up at six o'clock.

sentence: Wann stehst du am Wochenende auf?
translation_en: When do you get up on the weekend?
I go to sleep at ten.

sentence: Ich arbeite von acht bis fünf.
translation_en: I work from eight to five.

tip: Formal way to ask for an appointment.

translation_en: Today is the second of May.

sentence: Der vierte April ist mein Geburtstag.
translation_en: The fourth of April is my birthday.
That is the sixth of June.
Today is the seventh of July.
We are in the ninth month.

sentence: Ich bin am ersten Mai geboren.
translation_en: I was born on the first of May.

sentence: Mein Geburtsdatum ist der dritte März.
translation_en: My date of birth is the third of March.
Where is your place of birth?

tip: City names do not take articles.
translation_en: My place of birth is Frankfurt.
Yesterday I was at the cinema.

tip: Verbs of motion use 'sind' + Partizip II.

translation_en: I have thirty minutes of time.

sentence: Wann hast du den Test gemacht?
translation_en: When did you do the test?

sentence: Ich habe den Test gestern gemacht.

tip: Separable verbs add 'ge' in the middle (an-ge-rufen).

sentence: Er ist mit dem Zug gefahren.
Wir sind in den Bus eingestiegen.

translation_en: She got off at the train station.
